attchmntText: Ardee Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Ardee Industries Limited filed an investor presentation for an earnings conference call regarding the second quarter of the financial year 2026-27 ended 30th September 2026. The call is scheduled for 12th November 2026 at 05.30 P.M. The presentation is available on the company website. Chairman and Managing Director Sandeep Aggarwal stated the company is strengthening its position in the organized lead recycling industry. He cited favorable regulatory tailwinds from Battery Waste Management Rules and Reverse Charge Mechanism. The company reported FY26 revenue of INR 11,677 Mn and EBITDA of INR 1,471 Mn. Installed capacity stands at 1,56,950 MTPA. The brand Ardee Lead 9997 is listed on the London Metal Exchange and MCX. The company hedges 100% of lead price exposure through LME-based futures contracts.

attchmntText: Ardee Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Ardee Industries Limited approved its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 12, 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter was 3,258.30 million INR, with a profit after tax of 180.58 million INR. Earnings per share stood at 0.57 INR. For the half year, revenue from operations was 6,648.66 million INR, and profit after tax was 379.61 million INR. Earnings per share for the half year were 1.88 INR. The company reported a net cash outflow of 116.71 million INR from operating activities for the half year. Total assets as at September 30, 2026, were 5,454.04 million INR. The results were subjected to a limited review by Nangia & Co. LLP.
